neighbours.label: the qualifying noun of an evaluative 'in the X department' / 'X factor' idiom, predicting 'department' (lacking in the taste department)
fire: The laptop is fast, but it falls short in the speaker department.
Our new puppy is a little lacking in the brains department, bless him.
The hotel scores high in the cleanliness department, but the breakfast is weak.
Honestly, the sequel delivers in the action department from start to finish.
The gadget has a certain cool factor that kids love.
He's not exactly blessed in the patience department when traffic is bad.
The budget phone holds its own in the camera department for the price.
My grandmother was always generous in the cookie department at Christmas.
